fun_fact: The UK is facing a severe heatwave, and among the worst affected are people whose jobs keep them in places that get dangerously hot — builders, bakers, construction workers, drivers and paramedics. A campaign for a legal maximum working temperature, to bring England into line with other European countries, is gathering pace. Read more [here](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/aug/14/uk-workers-struggling-in-extreme-heat).
author: Anjana & Sailee
